title: Shockproof iPhone Case – with Neck Strap & Screen Protector
descriptionHtml:
Protect your phone – and keep it close

A dropped phone can mean an expensive repair. And always searching for your phone in your pocket or bag is both annoying and risky.

Shockproof protection with neck strap

The case has shock-absorbing edges and a built-in screen protector that protects against drops and scratches. With the detachable neck strap and wrist strap you always have your phone close at hand.

Features

  • Shock-absorbing edges for better drop protection
  • Built-in screen protector
  • Detachable neck strap and wrist strap
  • 360° full-coverage protection
  • Fits many iPhone models

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
